newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Foreningsbanken already has 40 pct backing merger.
newsitem.headline: Foreningsbanken already has 40 pct backing merger.

text.p: Swedish bank Foreningsbanken said on Thursday that 40 percent of its shareholders have already said they are in favour of the bank merging with Swedbank.
Releasing the merger prospectus, Foreningsbanken's chairman Bo Dockered said in a statement he expected shareholders representing more than 90 percent of shares to accept the offer.
The prospectus will be made public immediately and the acceptance period will run until May 15, the banks said.

The banks announced in February they planned to merge by offering Foreningsbanken's shareholders to swap seven A shares for two shares in the new bank and three preference shares in Foreningsbanken for one newly-issued share.
The merger is conditional on 90 percent acceptance by shareholders with the new bank to begin operations on January 1, 1998.
The new bank, to be called ForeningsSparbanken, will be Sweden's second largest bank after the merger of Handelsbanken and mortgage lender Stadshypotek.
It will have a strong position in the domestic household and agricultural sectors.
